title: HackWorld: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Exploiting Web Application Vulnerabilities
abstract: arXiv:2510.12200v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Web applications are prime targets for cyberattacks as gateways to critical services and sensitive data. Traditional penetration testing is costly and expertise-intensive, making it difficult to scale with the growing web ecosystem. While language model agents show promise in cybersecurity, modern web applications demand visual understanding, dynamic content handling, and multi-step interactions that only computer-use agents (CUAs) can perform. Yet, their ability to discover and exploit vulnerabilities through graphical interfaces remains largely unexplored. We present HackWorld, the first framework for systematically evaluating CUAs' capabilities to exploit web application vulnerabilities via visual interaction. translated_title: HackWorld：评估计算机操作代理利用Web应用程序漏洞的能力
translated_abstract: Web应用程序作为访问关键服务和敏感数据的门户，是网络攻击的主要目标。传统的渗透测试成本高昂且依赖专业知识，难以随着不断增长的Web生态系统进行规模化扩展。虽然语言模型代理在网络安全领域展现出潜力，但现代Web应用程序需要视觉理解、动态内容处理和多步骤交互能力，而只有计算机操作代理才能执行这些任务。然而，计算机操作代理通过图形界面发现和利用漏洞的能力在很大程度上尚未被探索。我们提出了HackWorld，这是首个通过视觉交互系统性评估计算机操作代理利用Web应用程序漏洞能力的框架。与经过简化的基准测试不同，HackWorld包含涵盖11种框架和7种语言的36个真实应用程序，具有注入漏洞、身份验证绕过和不安全输入处理等真实缺陷。
tldr: 提出了首个系统性评估框架HackWorld，通过视觉交互方式评估计算机操作代理利用真实Web应用程序漏洞的能力，涵盖36个跨11种框架和7种语言的真实应用。
en_tdlr: HackWorld is the first framework for systematically evaluating computer-use agents' capabilities to exploit real-world web application vulnerabilities through visual interaction, featuring 36 applications across 11 frameworks and 7 languages.
